Documentation and packaging patch for Seen for Mattermost.

## Changes

- Includes the current English and Russian README, ordinary README hyphens and updated installation/testing/release documentation in the install package.
- Adds package checks for ID/version, safe archive paths, required documents/licenses, relative links and executable permissions.
- Verifies that both Linux binaries and the web bundle have the same SHA256 as the verified 1.1.1 candidate.
- Draft preparation checks the downloaded artifact against the successful read-only CI job's SHA256, independently validates its report and preserves existing release assets.
- Retains the Go/dependency security fixes from 1.1.1. Backend/frontend runtime source, plugin ID, receipt API/KV format, first-view timestamp and viewport rules are unchanged.

## Install

Plugin ID: `ru.internal.mattermost.seen`. Target: Mattermost 11.10.x, minimum 11.10.0; Linux amd64/arm64, Web/Desktop.

Verify all downloaded assets using `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-1.1.2-github.txt`. Upload `ru.internal.mattermost.seen-1.1.2.tar.gz` through System Console plugin management as an update of the same ID. The source ZIP is not installable. Back up the previous package/settings, coordinate all app nodes, confirm version/settings and reload clients. No system database migration is required.

See the included `README.ru.md` and `docs/release-1.1.2.md` for the Russian runbook, acceptance and rollback. Previously validated 1.1.1 is KV-compatible and retains its dependency fixes; returning to 1.1.0 reintroduces the earlier advisories. Do not mix 1.0.0 writers with tombstone-aware versions.

## Verification and status

The draft helper runs only after successful frontend format/lint/typecheck/unit/build, Go race/vet, mock-browser smoke, source and packaged-binary vulnerability scans, module integrity, npm audit and package validation. `release-validation-1.1.2.json` records the exact commit/run ID, archive hash and runtime hashes. The source ZIP is from that exact commit.

This is a pre-release for test-environment acceptance. Live Mattermost gateway/authz/CSRF, functional, HA/failover and load acceptance remain pending. Automated tests use a mock host and do not establish production or HA support. Module-only GO-2026-5932 concerns unmaintained OpenPGP, which the plugin does not import; it is not presented as fixed.

**Viewed means the observation marker entered the viewport under the plugin's dwell/focus rules. It is not proof that a person read or understood the message.** Receipts remain best effort, and TTL does not remove database backups.

## Assets

- `ru.internal.mattermost.seen-1.1.2.tar.gz` - install package.
- `mattermost-seen-source-1.1.2-github.zip` - exact-commit source.
- `release-validation-1.1.2.json` - package-validation evidence.
- `SHA256SUMS-1.1.2-github.txt` - SHA256 of the three files above.

Portions of this project were generated or refactored with assistance from OpenAI Codex.
